title: A Woman Under the Influence
review_text:
'I remember before, when you were punching me in favor of your mother.' 
It’s raw, unfiltered emotion. The kind that leaves you breathless.

By the end, Mabel remains the same fragile woman she was before the institutionalization. And that’s the tragedy, not the illness, but the inability of people to meet her with compassion. If only people were gentler, more understanding.

This might be the best portrayal of mental illness and the stigma that surrounds it. Top notch performance by Gena Rowlands.

Classic!
